task_description: Agents need to collaboratively develop a software feature. The program requires writing code, conducting code reviews, testing, and integrating code changes to ensure a bug-free deployment.
expected_outcome: The software feature is implemented correctly, code is reviewed thoroughly, passes all tests, and integrates seamlessly without any conflicts.

agents.description: Responsible for writing initial code based on the given requirements.
Reviews the code written by the developer to identify and highlight any issues.
Tests the reviewed code to ensure it meets the required functionality and reports any bugs found.
Integrates the tested code into the main branch and resolves any conflicts that arise.

content.code: initial version of the feature implementation

content.feedback: code review notes with issues highlighted

content.code: revised version after feedback with wrong routing
reviewed and revised version possibly outdated

content.bugs: list of bugs found during testing
